pages.text: Tribute is paid once a day for 5 days: $(l)4 + 2 emeralds per city$() of the payer (at most 24).$(br2)You pay from your stockpiles, capital first; NPC towns pay from their treasury; Village Expansion villages levy theirs. Your tribute arrives in your capital's stockpile.

While tribute flows the two kingdoms cannot raid each other.$(br2)A day with $(l)nothing paid$() is a default: the tribute ends and the truce is broken, so war may follow. Keep emeralds in stock when you owe tribute.
